Level | Senior Frontend Engineer | REMOTE (US + international with US-ET overlap) | https://level.io

Level builds a modern Remote Monitoring & Management (RMM) platform for IT teams and Managed Service Providers. We help IT professionals monitor devices, automate workflows, remotely support users, and leverage AI to operate more efficiently.

We’re hiring a Senior Frontend Engineer to help us ship faster, including many features requested by our community.

You’ll work on real-time device management interfaces, remote control (WebRTC), visual automation workflows, and UI for AI-powered features. Strong experience with TypeScript, React, Next.js, and GraphQL preferred.

We are actively filling this role and will respond to applicants.

Full Details: https://level.io/careers/senior-frontend-engineer
